introduction.title: 1. Introduction
introduction.content: This Privacy Policy describes how we collect, use, disclose, and protect your personal information when you use the BorderLess platform. We are committed to protecting your privacy and handling your data with transparency and security.

information_collected.title: 2. Information We Collect
information_collected.content: We collect several types of information to provide and improve our services:

personal_info.title: Personal Information
personal_info.item_1: Name, email address, phone number, and company information when you create an account
personal_info.item_2: Resume and professional information uploaded by candidates
personal_info.item_3: Payment and billing information for subscriptions

usage_data.title: Usage Data
usage_data.item_1: Log data including IP address, browser type, and access times
usage_data.item_2: Platform usage patterns and feature interactions

how_we_use.title: 3. How We Use Your Information
how_we_use.content: We use the collected information for the following purposes:
how_we_use.purpose_1: Providing, maintaining, and improving our recruitment services
how_we_use.purpose_3: Sending important updates, security alerts, and support messages
how_we_use.purpose_4: Analyzing usage patterns to improve user experience
how_we_use.purpose_5: Complying with legal obligations and protecting our rights

data_sharing.title: 4. Data Sharing and Disclosure
data_sharing.content: We do not sell your personal information. We may share your data in the following circumstances:
data_sharing.scenario_1: With service providers who assist in operating our platform (e.g., cloud hosting, payment processors)
data_sharing.scenario_2: When required by law or to respond to legal processes
data_sharing.scenario_3: To protect the rights, property, or safety of our company, users, or the public

data_security.title: 5. Data Security
data_security.content: We implement industry-standard security measures to protect your information, including encryption, access controls, and regular security audits. For more details, please see our

data_retention.title: 6. Data Retention
data_retention.content: We retain your personal information for as long as necessary to provide our services and comply with legal obligations. When you delete your account, we will delete or anonymize your personal data within 90 days, except where retention is required by law.

your_rights.title: 7. Your Rights
your_rights.content: Depending on your location, you may have the following rights regarding your personal data:
your_rights.right_1: Access: Request a copy of your personal information
your_rights.right_2: Correction: Update or correct inaccurate information
your_rights.right_3: Deletion: Request deletion of your personal data
your_rights.right_4: Portability: Receive your data in a machine-readable format
your_rights.right_5: Objection: Object to certain processing of your data

cookies.title: 8. Cookies and Tracking Technologies
cookies.content: We use cookies and similar technologies to enhance your experience, analyze usage, and personalize content. You can control cookie preferences through your browser settings.

third_party_links.title: 9. Third-Party Links
third_party_links.content: Our platform may contain links to third-party websites or services. We are not responsible for the privacy practices of these external sites. We encourage you to review their privacy policies.

childrens_privacy.title: 10. Children's Privacy
childrens_privacy.content: Our services are not intended for individuals under 16 years of age. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children. If we become aware of such collection, we will delete the information immediately.

changes.title: 11. Changes to Privacy Policy
changes.content: We may update this Privacy Policy periodically. We will notify you of significant changes by email or through our platform. The 'Last Updated' date at the top indicates when changes were last made.

contact.title: 12. Contact Us
contact.content: If you have questions or concerns about this Privacy Policy or our data practices, please contact us:

security.title: Security Policy
security.commitment_notice: We are committed to protecting the security and privacy of your data. This policy outlines our comprehensive security measures.

introduction.title: 1. Introduction
introduction.content: At BorderLess, security is our top priority. This Security Policy outlines the technical and organizational measures we implement to protect your data from unauthorized access, disclosure, alteration, and destruction.

encryption.title: 2. Data Encryption
encryption.content: We employ industry-standard encryption to protect your data:
encryption.measure_1: TLS/SSL encryption for all data in transit between your browser and our servers
encryption.measure_2: AES-256 encryption for sensitive data at rest in our databases
encryption.measure_3: Encrypted backups stored in geographically distributed locations

access_controls.title: 3. Access Controls
access_controls.content: We implement strict access controls to ensure only authorized personnel can access your data:
access_controls.control_1: Role-based access control (RBAC) limiting data access to specific user roles
access_controls.control_2: Multi-factor authentication (MFA) required for administrative access
access_controls.control_3: Regular access audits and automatic session timeouts
access_controls.control_4: Principle of least privilege for all system access

infrastructure.title: 4. Infrastructure Security
infrastructure.content: Our infrastructure is built with security in mind:
infrastructure.measure_1: Cloud hosting with enterprise-grade security providers
infrastructure.measure_2: Firewalls and intrusion detection systems monitoring all network traffic
infrastructure.measure_3: Regular security patches and updates to all systems
infrastructure.measure_4: Isolated development, staging, and production environments

application_security.title: 5. Application Security
application_security.content: We follow secure development practices throughout our software lifecycle:
application_security.practice_1: Regular code reviews and security testing
application_security.practice_2: Protection against common vulnerabilities (SQL injection, XSS, CSRF)
application_security.practice_3: Automated security scanning in our CI/CD pipeline
application_security.practice_4: Third-party security audits and penetration testing

backup.title: 6. Data Backup and Recovery
backup.content: We maintain comprehensive backup and disaster recovery procedures. All data is automatically backed up daily with encrypted storage in multiple geographic locations. We regularly test our recovery procedures to ensure business continuity.

incident_response.title: 7. Incident Response
incident_response.content: We have a formal incident response plan to address potential security incidents:
incident_response.step_2: Immediate investigation and containment of security incidents
incident_response.step_3: Notification to affected users within 72 hours of confirmed breaches
incident_response.step_4: Post-incident analysis and implementation of preventive measures

employee_training.title: 8. Employee Training
employee_training.content: All employees receive comprehensive security training, including data handling best practices, phishing awareness, and incident reporting procedures. Security training is mandatory and conducted regularly.

third_party.title: 9. Third-Party Security
third_party.content: We carefully vet all third-party service providers and require them to maintain security standards comparable to our own. All third-party integrations are reviewed for security compliance before implementation.

compliance.title: 10. Compliance
compliance.content: We maintain compliance with relevant security standards and regulations:
compliance.standard_1: GDPR (General Data Protection Regulation) compliance for EU users
compliance.standard_3: Industry-specific regulations applicable to recruitment and HR data

user_responsibilities.title: 11. Your Responsibilities
user_responsibilities.content: While we implement robust security measures, security is a shared responsibility. Please:
user_responsibilities.responsibility_1: Use strong, unique passwords and enable multi-factor authentication
user_responsibilities.responsibility_3: Report suspicious activity or security concerns immediately
user_responsibilities.responsibility_4: Ensure your devices and network connections are secure

reporting.title: 12. Reporting Security Issues
reporting.alert: If you discover a security vulnerability, please report it responsibly to help us protect all users.
reporting.content: If you identify a potential security vulnerability or incident, please report it immediately to our security team. We appreciate responsible disclosure and will acknowledge receipt within 24 hours.

updates.title: 13. Updates to Security Policy
updates.content: We continuously improve our security measures and will update this policy as needed. Significant changes will be communicated through our platform and via email.

outreach.prospect_intro: Recommended sources for finding staffing and staff augmentation companies — the ideal customers for Borderless ATS.
outreach.prospect_tip_clutch: Filter by 'IT Staff Augmentation' and 'Nearshore'. Contact the CEO or Head of Talent directly from the company profile.
outreach.prospect_tip_goodfirms: Sort by 'Best Match' or 'Most Reviewed'. Many companies have a visible contact email on their profile.
outreach.prospect_tip_linkedin: Search 'staff augmentation' as a keyword. Use 'Staffing & Recruiting' and 'IT Services' industry filters. Companies with 11–200 employees are the ideal target.
outreach.prospect_tip_sales_nav: Create a saved list with filters: industry=Staffing, title=CEO/Founder/COO, target country. Shows who viewed your profile.
outreach.prospect_tip_upwork: Agencies on Upwork often have the owner's email visible. Send an agency request + outreach message simultaneously.
outreach.prospect_tip_toptal: Google: 'Toptal alternative Latin America' or 'staff augmentation LATAM'. Toptal competitors are exactly your ICP.
outreach.prospect_tip_google_maps: Search your target country or region on Google Maps. Many local companies don't appear on Clutch but have a Google Business profile with phone and email.
outreach.prospect_tip_sia: Review annual 'Fastest Growing' and 'Largest Staffing Firms' rankings. Companies ranked 50–200 tend to be the ideal size.
outreach.prospect_tip_reddit: Search posts mentioning 'ATS' or 'applicant tracking'. Add value by commenting before doing outreach. Very active community.
outreach.prospect_tip_crunchbase: Filter by 'Staffing & Recruiting', country, and size. CSV export is available on the free plan with a daily limit.
outreach.workflow_step_1: Scrape Clutch.co (filter: IT Staff Augmentation + LATAM/Europe). Export a list with company name, website, and LinkedIn.
outreach.workflow_step_2: Find the CEO or Head of Talent for each company on LinkedIn. Save profile + URL.
outreach.workflow_step_3: Send a LinkedIn connection request using Template #1 (see 'Message Templates' tab).
outreach.workflow_step_4: 48h after they connect: send the post-connect message (Template #2). If you have an email, send the cold email in parallel (Template #3).
outreach.workflow_step_5: Follow up with Template #4 at day 5 and Template #5 at day 12 if no reply. Track status in a spreadsheet or CRM.
